body:
Hi team,

Something odd is happening on the KO's Landscaping homepage. The whole 'Our Landscaping Services' section appears twice, word for word, one right after the other. The paver and travertine card also describes tree services, planting, pruning and removal, which looks like a copy and paste slip, and the stat counters on the page render as zeros.

Anyone in Glendale pricing up a yard project who lands there will notice.

So I rebuilt the KO's homepage and attached it to this email as a PDF. Every service appears once, the paver and travertine section actually talks about pavers and travertine, and your finished project photos lead the page instead of sitting further down.

Landscaping sites are a big part of what I build. Texas Landscape (texaslandscape.com) is one of mine, services presented once, cleanly, with photos doing the selling. NH Landscape Garden (nhlandscapegarden.com) is another, simple pages that make a small crew look established.

Have a look and tell me what you think. If it works for you, I can build it out on koslawn.com for real. No strings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: KO's Landscaping (KO's Landscaping LLC)
subject: 🌿 KO's, your services section shows up twice
